name: io.github.meshjs/mesh-ai-mcp
description: Real-time, retrieval-augmented MeshJS SDK documentation and Cardano dev context for AI agents.
title: Mesh AI MCP Server

environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the provider behind MODEL (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google).

environmentVariables.name: MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model identifier used to answer questions, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-20250514, or gemini-1.5-pro.

environmentVariables.name: MESH_AI_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Mesh AI backend URL. Defaults to https://mimir-api.meshjs.dev.
